description: Three training-curve panels for the first stage: Accuracy Reward, Format Reward and Completion Length. Each shows a smoothed line over scattered raw points, sampled every five steps.
uncertain: The shaded areas under each curve carry no separate data.
All values are read from pixel positions against the axis ticks, so they are approximate (about ±0.02 for the reward panels and ±1 for completion length).
